subject: simplified XXH_PREFETCH_DIST logic (#375)
perf_evidence: The diff changes the compiler/ISA-specific prefetch distance used in XXH3's stripe loop, including Clang AVX2 and GCC AVX512 paths.
change_summary: Replace separate AVX512 64/128-bit prefetch distances with one configurable XXH_PREFETCH_DIST. Clang uses 320, GCC AVX512 uses 512, other GCC paths use 384.
